source.meaning: Exact working source including preserved old dirty/untracked files and v5 coordination edits. Base SHA is not a whole-app PASS.

bootstrapRules: Read the predecessor manifest and verify its archive hash before import. Preserve the origin unchanged.

Require the recorded base HEAD before applying the overlay. Inspect destination changes: accept clean-base bytes or already matching manifest bytes only; diagnose unexpected differences instead of overwriting them.
Validate every archive entry stays inside the destination workspace and is present in the manifest; do not extract .git, absolute paths, traversal entries or unlisted files.
Restore exact bytes for the listed working source, verify every SHA256 and copy the manifest itself. Record that source verification precedes any implementation.
Use a feature/ branch for source writes. Do not checkout the origin's already-owned branch in a second worktree. Preserve the accepted input SHA and source fingerprint.
Confirm predecessor writer is released for this dispatch ID. Claim the successor state with the actual thread/worktree and start S01; predecessor copies remain historical.
Do not fork full conversation history, open duplicate successors, reset/clean the origin, or equate setup completion with acceptance.
instructions: Implement S01-A: inspect actual feature/domain/content/media interfaces and create reuse/dependency/uncertainty registers mapping all 14 workflows, 14 existing mode IDs and six proposed activity families.

Continue S01-B draft material and S01-C independent prototype work within the approved plan. Split to one fresh successor at a bounded checkpoint if context or work-package boundaries warrant it. Do not stop after acknowledgement or a plan-only reply.

S01-D and instructional Flutter implementation stay gated by reviewed media, real participants and relevant trial evidence. Continue authorized independent work while those prerequisites are unavailable.
Before production/prototype feature changes use relevant debugging/TDD/verification skills and verify the actual changed behavior; no implementation-mirroring tests or heavy unrelated gates.
At each boundary record source/evidence/open defects/next action. Preserve RED and external pending. A chat ending does not close the sprint or an acceptance row.
recoveryPolicy: Recoverable command/path/test failures require stopping the failed method, inspecting real paths/symbols, diagnosing and repairing, then bounded retesting and continuing. Do not blind retry, weaken acceptance or declare blocked solely due repeated commands. Only a new user pause or indispensable external prerequisite with no useful independent authorized work can stop that scope.
authorization: User explicitly approved plan v5 implementation and sequential per-sprint/per-package chats on 2026-09-24; no repeat permission needed for that work. New user steering takes precedence.
